plans.rationale: This is the current coaching focus from the most recent (and so far only) lesson on record — not enough lesson history yet to call it a recurring pattern. The plan front-loads foundational work on it because it's what's live right now, then progresses to transfer and pressure-testing before the next lesson.

weekly_structure.theme: Isolate the feel with slow, exaggerated reps of step-change-of-direction and pump-drill.
Add speed to the drills and start transferring the sequencing feel into full swings.
Pressure-test the new sequencing with a target/scoring game.
